tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over). file:// URLs open files inside the desktop.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the history. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over). Element refs from it stay valid across calls while the page is unchanged. Its boxes are page-viewport CSS pixels, not screenshot pixels.

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into editable element. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over element on page. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Handle a dialog. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload one or multiple files. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over). `paths` are absolute paths of files inside the desktop (e.g. /home/agent/Downloads/report.pdf); copy host files in with file_put first.

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

time.description: The time to wait in seconds, at most 30

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

url.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Returns all console messages. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests. Acts on the desktop's own visible Chromium (the user can watch and take over).

index.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

desktop.description: Which desktop: an id from desktop_start or desktop_list. Defaults to this session's first desktop (started automatically if there is none).

excluded.browser_close: closes the shared browser the user is watching; agents never own the browser
excluded.browser_resize: the window is maximised to the desktop; resizing it would desync screenshots and the user's view
excluded.browser_take_screenshot: duplicates deskhand's screenshot/zoom (which show the whole desktop) and writes files on the manager
excluded.browser_install: the desktop image ships Chromium; nothing to install (and it would run on the manager)
excluded.browser_run_code_unsafe: runs arbitrary JavaScript in the manager process, which holds the Docker socket (root-equivalent on the host)
excluded.browser_emulate_media: changes how pages render for the user watching the shared browser; rarely needed for tasks
excluded.browser_drop: file paths would be read from the manager's filesystem; use browser_drag, left_click_drag or browser_file_upload instead
excluded.browser_pdf_save: writes to the manager's filesystem, not the desktop's (print to PDF inside Chromium or use desktop_exec instead)
